blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court (SC) has ruled that a child born during a valid marriage is considered a “legitimate child” even if the birth certificate does not include the name of the father. In a decision promulgated on April 7, 2026, the SC’s Third Division granted a woman’s petition to correct her birth certificate, in which her father’s name was omitted, and her surname given was only that of her mother.
